jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager - Data Centres - Contract - Madrid

Our client, a developer of multi-customer and hyperscale data centres in Europe and Asia-Pacific, have an exciting opportunity for a Project Manager to join their current project in the Netherlands. They have a strong portfolio of constructing world-class critical infrastructure and are chosen time and again for their resilient power and colling, robust securing and sophisticated monitoring systems.
• *Project Manager Responsibilities**:
Ensure the use of ‘project management systems, procedures and processes to ensure that external consultants and the internal team interface in the successful completion of the project.
Ensure policies and procedures are fully flowed in respect of change management, site access and timely availability of document for risk assessment and planned works
Maintaining a strong focus on contractor management and performance, establishing, and managing relationships with key stakeholders
Prepare project... budgets, including documents for tender and negotiations with all internal and external stakeholders.
Prepare RFAs for each project
Evaluate job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods and cost-effectiveness of plans
• *About you**:
Relevant engineering degree
Spanish speaking (highly preferred)
7 years + experience in a related role
Data Centre or critical infrastructure experience
Able to relate well to key project stakeholders internally and externally
Holds a strong level of attention to detail.
Are you a good fit for this Project Manager position? We want to hear from you. Get in touch with us today.

To view Quanta's privacy policy, please visit our website

jobs_results.title: SEO Project Manager - Stage de fin d'études
jobs_results.description:
Contexte
• Le/la SEO Project Manager Finance et Assurance est intégré.e au pôle Finance & Assurance & Rénovation énergétique à Madrid.
• Le pôle Finance, Assurance & Rénovation Énergétique de Selectra est le pôle le plus jeune du Groupe en France. Créée il y 4 ans, cette business unit a connu une croissance continue dans la lignée des activités cœur du Groupe, l’Énergie et les Télécoms. Dans un environnement intrapreneurial et particulièrement collaboratif, l’ambition du pôle est de devenir une référence dans le monde du courtage en assurance et dans la comparaison des offres de finance. Le leitmotiv du pôle est : “Agir vite et bien”
• Sous la supervision de la responsable de la Business Unit Finance & Assurance, Luka Payras et en étroite collaboration avec tous les membres de l’équipe, vous contribuez à la définition de la stratégie SEO et business du pôle.
• Améliorer le référencement web de nos sites en créant de nouveaux contenus optimisés SEO, en optimisant l’existant, en... investiguant de nouvelles opportunités lexicales. Développer vos capacités analytiques et organisationnelles en reportant mensuellement vos KPIs, en analysant les performances d’un site, en corrigeant les bugs ou en apportant un soutien sur des projets marketing transversaux.

Mission 1 : Développer et maintenir le positionnement de nos contenus dédiés à la Finance et à l’Assurance
• Développement rapide de votre expertise sur l’assurance afin de garantir la parfaite exactitude des contenus publiés
• Création de nouveaux articles selon les principes SEO
• Optimisation des contenus existants dans le but de gagner des positions ainsi que du trafic
• Selon le niveau du candidat, gestion d’un freelance : création de briefs, relecture des guides et facturation

Mission 2 : Mener des analyses technique d’un site web
• Réalisation de crawls à l’aide d’outils techniques et correction des erreurs soulevées (erreurs 4xx, redirections, etc.)
• Reporting et analyse des résultats mensuels du site
• Analyses des monétisations et du marché afin de trouver la stratégie commerciale la plus performante
• Faire un content gap pour trouver de nouvelles opportunités de mots-clés

Mission 3 : Améliorer la notoriété de Selectra Assurance
• Lancement d’opérations de marketing pour faire connaître l’expertise de Selectra en matière assurantielle dans les médias (études de marché, vidéo, support de formation etc.).
Compétences à acquérir durant le stage
• Les fondamentaux du SEO et des contenus optimisés
• Les bases en langage HTML
• Le CMS drupal
• Les logiciels d’analyse : ahrefs, screaming frog, Google search console, Google analytics
• Connaissances sur le secteur de l’assurance
• Compétences en gestion de projet

Pourquoi Selectra?
• Madrid ! Vous serez séduit par cette ville à l’atmosphère et à la culture de rêve où chacun se sent le bienvenu.
• Une entreprise avec un esprit start-up : la flexibilité et la réactivité sont au cœur de notre ADN, et chez nous l’ambiance de travail est détendue.
• Une entreprise véritablement internationale : nous comptons plus de 20 nationalités et faisons en sorte que vous puissiez parler avec tout le monde en offrant des cours de langue gratuits !
• Des événements d’entreprise réguliers : nous travaillons dur mais aimons nous détendre une fois le travail terminé : nous organisons des événements d’équipe mensuels ainsi que 3 afterworks par an.
• Une équipe dynamique qui sera là pour vous former et vous aider : vous serez responsabilisé.e tout au long de votre parcours tout en étant épaulé.e par votre équipe.
• Nous sommes bons dans ce que nous faisons : vous rejoindrez l’une des meilleures équipes de référencement en Europe et ferez partie d’une équipe internationale et multiculturelle de plus de 60 responsables de contenu travaillant quotidiennement sur le référencement.
• Nous nous soucions de votre santé et de votre bien-être :
• des tarifs préférentiels pour l’assurance maladie privée (gratuite après un an dans l’entreprise)
• des tarifs préférentiels sur votre abonnement Gym.
• Des fruits frais livrés chaque semaine
• Mais surtout, nous ne laissons jamais des situations malsaines s’installer sans réagir afin de garder un environnement de travail serein pour tous.tes.
• Nous vous aidons à vous installer dans votre nouvelle ville grâce à d’autres avantages (Diverclick, …

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Supply Chain
jobs_results.description: Job Description: Would you like to contribute to a company that has ‘’Feeding the Future’’ as its mission? Do you have experience as a Project Manager? Are you looking for a new challenge in an international animal nutrition company? Then Nutreco has this interesting position for you! What are you going to do? Nutreco's mission is to feed the future. We develop and provide innovative feed technologies, premixes and unique software solutions and services for the animal nutrition industry. In order to continue to fulfill our ambition as a market leader, the intrinsic demands for the growing business and customer support, the company is further investing in the area of Operations. The roles will give you a unique opportunity to work on Quality, HSE and Efficiency Improvement projects. As well as to co-create and further develop our models and solutions with access to a multi-disciplinary and highly motivated team. What are your key accountabilities? Project management Starting from the... high-level key deliverables (Masterplan) already defined and approved, you will lead the Planning phase in order to create an accurate Project Management Plan (PMP with baselines on scope, costs, steps, milestones and time etc.) Lead the Network Optimization project according to Nutreco project management methodology (based on PMI principles) Constantly review the project requirements and scope in accordance with stakeholder expectations and form project teams (internal and/or external). Identify risks, assess impact and severity. Have in place a risk mitigation plan. Coordinate decision-making meetings and make proposals to the Steering Committee. Materialize Quick Wins already identified, coordinating the teams to achieve them, and coordinate product allocation, production phase-in and phase-out. Ensure the successful completion of the project in terms of scope, schedule, costs and stakeholder management. Monitoring and auditing Generate reports regarding project status, including incidents and risks. Track and report on the project budget, scope, and schedule. Track operational efficiencies defined in the project and review with controlling team its contribution to cost reduction. Leadership and people management: Capable to build strong (national and multicultural) relationships, have excellent communication and network skills. Manage and coach a project team without having hierarchical authority; motivate employees through sincere and concrete feedback and take appropriate action when needed, to insure they are performing in accordance with their project objectives. Compliance Ensure that all activities are prepared and executed in line with all relevant Nutreco and local safety regulations and procedures (work permits, LoTo, etc.), as well as technical standards, regulations, procedures, instructions and guidelines. Signal potential hazardous and / or unsafe situations on site and during construction activities, take appropriate action in case of imminent unsafe situations. What we offer Flexible working hours and hybrid model work Reduced working hours on Fridays and over summer 26 days of paid vacation Subsidised meals in our canteen Private health insurance (partly paid by the company) Personal development programs, online training, and opportunities to get involved in different projects depending on your interests Regular company and team events What you need to succeed Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or technical field (PMP certified strongly preferred) Proven international experience in strategic interdepartmental projects Experience with project management SW tools. Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills, hands-on mentality, and result-driven Previous experience working on process standardization Able to demonstrate strong numerical capability with a passion for detailed analysis Interpersonal skills, stakeholder management, open to listening to others' ideas, builds and maintains strong relationships, and has cross-cultural awareness Fluent in both English/Spanish Willingness to travel across Spain and Portugal (10%) Extra information / Apply direct Are you the perfect candidate we are looking for? We would like to hear from you! You can express your interest in this role by clicking the button “apply online’’ and we will contact you as soon as possible. In case you do apply, we like to thank you for sharing your ambition with us! Our organisation: Trouw Nutrition is the global leader in innovative feed specialties, premixes and nutritional services for the animal nutrition industry. Trouw Nutrition provides species-specific nutritional solutions consisting of feed concepts, products and nutritional know-how. The unique combination of products, models and services Trouw Nutrition offers, boosts productivity and supports animal health through all life stages, contributing to our customers' peace of mind. Trouw Nutrition's nutrition solutions have met the need of farmers and home-mixers, feed producers, integrators and distributors. Trouw Nutrition has locations in 25 countries and around 5000 employees. Our mission is Feeding the Future. Equal Opportunity Employer: Trouw Nutrition is an equal opportunity employer; applicants are considered for all roles without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, military status or any other status protected by applicable local law. Please advise us at any point during the recruitment and selection process if you require accommodation. Trouw Nutrition is committed to compliance with all applicable legislation, including providing accommodation for applicants with disabilities. Nutreco is a global leader in animal nutrition and aquafeed. Our advanced nutritional solutions are at the origin of food for millions of consumers worldwide. Its two global company brands Skretting (aqua feed) and Trouw Nutrition (animal nutrition) have sales in over 90 countries. Our purpose Feeding the Future captures a big challenge: feeding 9 billion people in 2050. Our responsibility is twofold: we need to make a significant contribution to meeting the rapid increase in worldwide demand for food; on the other hand, we need to find the right balance in order that we can realize growth while making also responsible choices for people and planet. We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and competence of our people. Our values; capable, caring, collaborative, and innovative are supportive of those three core elements. To know more about us, please visit our website https://www.nutreco.com

jobs_results.title: Project Manager EMEA
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager EMEA

Who We Are:

Headquartered in Atlantic Canada with offices across the United States and around the world, Bulletproof has two decades in the security business, protecting its clients’ privacy and data. The company’s footprint now includes users on six continents trusting Bulletproof to secure their identities, networks, data, and devices.  Driven by innovative, empowered and creative teamwork, we build solutions that solve business challenges and deliver overall business improvement for our global clients. At Bulletproof, we are committed to our customers, our team and our communities. Bulletproof's practices include Security and Network Operations Centres, Cybersecurity Testing & Audit, Quality Assurance and Testing, Microsoft Consulting, Managed Services, and Product Fulfilment; working together to provide true end-to-end business solutions. Why You Should Work With Us: Bulletproof is a Gold Microsoft Partner, a TWO TIME Microsoft Canada Modern Workplace IMPACT... Award winner, and crowned the 2021 Microsoft Security Partner of the Year. We are passionate about helping our customers achieve more securely. We are growing! Our mandate to expand our capacity and market reach is aggressive. We are building the team to help us achieve those goals; in Canada, in the USA, in Europe and Internationally. We have ambitious plans to leverage our depth of experience across our practices.

=PLEASE APPLY ONLY IF YOU LIVE IN ITALY, SPAIN, SLOVENIA, BULGARIA, NETHERLANDS OR THE UK AND HAVE AN EUROPEAN PASSPORT =

Description:
Bulletproof is seeking a Project Manager (PM). You will manage the projects through a full project life cycle for client and internal projects and be responsible for the delivery of them.
You will provide positive and effective leadership to a team consisting of Auditors, Penetration testers, Quality Assurance Testers, Change Management Auditors.
The successful candidate will be working in a team-based, results-driven environment. This can be a remote position.
Role Responsibilities

Manage multiple projects concurrently.
Lead projects through all phases of the project life cycle to completion, including planning, scheduling, budgeting of resources both internal and external, project controls, risk analysis, reporting, and executing all activities required for each project.
Create a work plan that includes a schedule with dependencies, milestones, risks, and issues.
Produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports as defined for a project.
Financial reporting on projects as determined for a project and minimally at the completion of a milestone.
Ensure compliance with fixed price contracts with clients.
Manage and oversee utilization and capacity individually and collaboratively with managers and other PMs.
Interface directly with managers, employees, clients, partners, and others to clearly define project requirements and manage expectations.
Liaise with clients, taking time to understand clients’ evolving needs, developing the client relationship through effective communication and personal skills, and building trust through repeated, timely, and effective project delivery.
Communicate effectively with the global team in a fast-paced work environment.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal PM development, supporting materials, and process training documentation.
Promote and practice company values while leading staff and nurturing a creative, innovative, and enjoyable work environment.
Assist the team with completing tasks as necessary to complete the projects successfully.

Required Experience and Certification

Bachelor’s degree in any subject area.
Minimum six years project management experience.
Experience in the IT Services.
PMP or PRINCE 2 certification is considered an asset.

Soft Skills

Positive attitude.
Empathetic team member able to build strong relationships with clients and team members.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical eye for details.
Able to work effectively with minimal supervision.
Excellent time management, task planning, and prioritization skills.
Life cycle management of an eLearning development.
Strong proactive project management skills.
Understanding of adult learning theory.
Able to adapt quickly to changing client and team requirements.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional remote teams.
Proficient with Microsoft Office.
Skilled at creating schedules for shared resources.
Proactive in identifying and resolving issues and working through challenges with a positive attitude.
Leadership and relationship-building skills.
Able to meet deadlines.
Able to document issues, alternatives, and recommendations in an effective manner suitable for manager consumption.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Bulletproof is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Bulletproof is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Order-to-Cash (Unify)
jobs_results.description:
Schneider has started a journey to UNIFY its Business Processes (across the different Business Model – Transactional, Projects, Service, Software) in order to;
• Simplify the life of our people.
• Standardize our business processes and IT landscape to react and scale faster
• Harmonize our data foundations to drive better decisions
• Enhance our customers’ and suppliers’ digital journeys

This major project, which is sponsored and driven by the Excom to design and implement the way Schneider will operate over the next 20 years, will involve hundreds of stakeholders and needs very strong coordination and stakeholder management.

We have decided to deploy the Fit2Standard approach with the following steps :
• Leverage SAP process map as a starting point
• Together with Order2Cash / GSC / Finance and Data Unify Domains, extend them to cover an End2End scope covering the complete digital and data architecture (ERP + Global apps)
• Engage with countries to review, adopt and validate what... will become the Schneider global standard processes to drive our business

The Order to Cash Template Project Manager is the catalyst of the Template of the Unify Fit2Standard solution with BPOs and SAP. He/She will make sure that all actions are planned and executed in full coordination with Stream Leaders; SAP expert and our Global BPOs. He/she will participate in all interactions with BPOs to measure the level of alignment, define the development needs / corrective actions and contribute to the creation of the Order to Cash Template.

He/she is accountable for planning, preparation and co-ordination of the Order to Cash UNIFY Template, consisting of the Business Processes, Specifications for ERP, Integration specification and links to Best of Breed solution to ensure Unify is successfully implemented.

Missions
• Prepare and implement the Order to Cash Template across all Business Streams; Transactional, Projects, Equipment, Service & Software, defined details and planning actions & resources needed
• Together with Stream Leaders, BPOs and SAP experts plan, implement, anticipate risks and manage all dependencies relative to the Order to Cash Template
• Become the trusted advisor for BPOs during the Template creation
• Coordinate and bring the voice of BPOs and SAP experts to the central team. Bring the point of concerns and development needed

Responsibilities
• Coordinates/monitor the Order to Cash Template for the deployment. Define the actions to make the BPOs and SAP are ready and animate accordingly.
• Readiness
• Assessment of the GAP between target standard solution
• Acknowledge the digital landscape: integration, data & SAP expertise
• Support the profiling and the placement of the needed resources and make sure they are staffed in each Domain/Business Unit
• Consolidates the status updates for Order to Cash Template for all Domains and Businesses to be presented to the Order to Cash Leaders.
• Prepare and execute the communication plan with all stakeholders
• Align program team on expectations / deliverables / priorities
• Coordination and facilitation of the BPOs engagement plan for the selected Streams
• Participate to the interviews with Individual interviews to validate business requirements and integration specifications
• Participate to key Workshops together with SAP Experts, SE Process Leads and Schneider Digital Product Managers for all streams. Ensure the quality of outputs and consideration of critical points for the standard solution/ Template.
• Overall Template Program plan : Under the functional leadership of the Unify Order to Cash PMO, leverage the Unify Program management tools to plan, implement, manage timelines & identify risks / dependencies for all critical actions aiming at formalizing the Order to Cash Template

Success Profile
• Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills with a team-oriented approach
• Be able to find the best common solution between different stakeholders, when starting from different opinions
• Ability to work within an international environment, embracing different mindsets
• Capability to directly interact with Senior leaders, both in countries and at Global level
• Ability to find solutions to solve issues (vs. report problems)
• Strong project management skills to follow up on actions points decided after workshops and make sure results are delivered within agreed deadlines
• Strong C-level written communication (incl. Powerpoint re-use skills)
• Understands and leverages cultural differences to make Unify successful
• Excellent at tracking dependencies and plan them with the other Unify teams
• Self-motivated, Energetic, Creative, Confident and able to articulate at multiple levels within an organization.

At Schneider Electric, Diversity & Inclusion is at the heart of our organisation, it's an integral part of our history, culture, and identity. We recognise that embracing diversity unlocks innovation and creativity and fosters collaboration. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our communities and the customers we serve. As a result, our teams are stronger to drive the company's future.

“We are proudly participating in the Disability Confident Program offering support to people in the workplace who consider themselves living with a disability.”

jobs_results.description:
Company Description
Localsoft, S.L. is a world-class localization company offering translation, testing and audio services. From our headquarters in the Málaga TechPark, Spain, we operate both locally and internationally with clients from many different business sectors including leading brands in the Games, IT, Legal and Business industries.

We are expanding and currently hiring an experienced and dynamic Video Game Localization Project Manager to work in our fast-paced Localization Department with English as our main language of communication.

Visit: www.localsoftgames.com

Role

As a Localization Project Manager, you will manage multilingual projects in a deadline-driven environment taking full ownership of your projects from RFQ to final delivery, ensuring successful project completion and customer satisfaction.
• University degree: BA or MA in Translation, Philology, Linguistics or similar
• A minimum of 3 years of Localization Project Management experience
• Outstanding... Project Management skills: communication, planning, organization
• Able to successfully solve unexpected issues with minor impact and with a proactive and positive “can do” attitude
• Able to manage multilingual projects in a deadline-driven environment
• Able to negotiate effectively
• Games industry experience
• Quality evaluation practices and tools
• CAT Tools: Advanced user (agency), especially memoQ
• IT literacy: especially Microsoft Office suite
• Languages: English with full working proficiency, Japanese is desired, other languages are a plus
• Experience working with ISO-based requirements is a plus
• Experience with Japanese customers is a plus

Responsibilities
• Ensure customer satisfaction
• Successful project execution and delivery according to clients' expectations, time and budget requirements
• Full ownership of each localization phase
• Proposal creation, project analysis, planning and scheduling
• Risk analysis and mitigation plans
• Resource selection, monitoring and management
• Quality assurance
• Status reports
• Cost tracking
• Project admin, post-mortems, meeting minutes, etc.
• Follow and create procedures making recommendations for process improvements

• Full-time position in a well-established localization/testing company
• Opportunity to work with a professional international team in a dynamic and friendly work environment
• Opportunity to work with renowned clients worldwide
• Opportunity to work on exciting game projects
• 23 Paid holidays per calendar year
• 12 paid bank holidays per calendar year
• Summer timetable
• Free yearly medical check
• Cafeteria & Games
• Soft Drinks
• Fresh Fruit
• Free parking
• Relocation pack

jobs_results.title: Project Installation Manager (PrYM)
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80.000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Installation Manager in Madrid we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your Project Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll plan and manage all Installation activities for the project in support to the Project Manager ensuring application of the project’s strategy (including QCD commitment) and compliance with D&IS SIG and SECURITY strategy, policies, standards, local regulations and professional standards. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with... teams across the business (Project Manager and Project Core Team, Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager, Regional Centre EHS Manager)

You’ll specifically take care of managing internal interfaces within Project: Projects Engineering, Industrial, Supply Chain, Test and Commissioning, Sourcing, …; and external technical interfaces: Partners, Third Parties and Customers.

We’ll look to you for:
• Organising the Installation work (To be described in the Project Installation Management Plan) and Manages Installation Work Package (QCD). Monthly Work Package review with PM to control, analyses and evaluates costs and resources evolution, deviations, material, schedule, Risk identification and mitigation plan for Installation activities, … under the required tool (ADEL)…
• Delivering engineering studies (Bill of Installation Materials / Quantities, Method Statements, Installation Materials Specification Requirements, Installation drawings and configuration)
• Assisting procurement (Focus on Installation supplier)
• Preparing and managing Installation (Installation work, Work permit, Interface with Warehouse, …) including Installation supplier and Subcontractor / Installer
• Ensuring EHS on field with guidance and support from the Project team member in charge of Project EHS coordination Adheres to Alstom zero deviation policies and makes sure installer or sub-contractor follow the Alstom EHS polices.
• Monitoring / managing QCD performances (including EHS and RSA –Railway Safety), reporting and anticipating issues and monitoring milestone progress dashboard with regular project KPI reports.
• Assessing monthly the subcontractor and generates / acquiring from sub-contractor: Action plan progress, report, review and progress.
• Deploying and making sure the SIG and SECURITY Installation Process is applied as per the tailoring rules agreed with the RC IM. It is including:
• Regular updates of Installation Strategy Checklist, -Subcontractor share of responsibility and share of works as per project dynamics
• Performs / Acquires site investigations, surveys and field inspections as required by the customer or project needs
• Plans and schedules Installation activities as per handover from installation to T&C plan
• Reviews and signs off all installation design including: Installation Method statement, drawings, and manages site copies of drawing with Red & Yellow / Mark-ups, reviews and analyses subcontractor daily/weekly installation report. Manage of Punch list and regular follow-ups to close them. Ensures that “as built” drawings are in place before revenue service, including “as installed” configuration
• Reviews of Installation BOQ and updates as per project requirements. Supervising first article inspections and getting approvals from end user. Generates Traceability to installation requirements
• Lists Installation tools and organises regular inspections (calibration dates, notice to use, etc )
• Leads, manages, organizes and plans the installation activities with Alstom Installation Team and/or Subcontractors. Takeover of building / work place report (Civil works reception) –including punch list of remaining works to be done
• Decides start of work as per 4M Checklist for starting Installation Engineering and site installation activities
• Makes REX of Project installation activities and report on action.
• Supporting other Project worldwide as per RC IM request and participate to Process / “Metier” improvement workgroup as per RC IM request.

Organisational Reporting

Direct reporting: Regional Center Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Functional report line to Project Manager (during project execution)

Key Network & Links

Project Manager and Project Core Team

Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Regional Centre EHS Manager

Performance Measurement

Quality Cost Delivery (QCD)

Savings through Risk mitigation and Opportunities management, Cash by sales milestones achievement

Quality, EHS, RSA (Railway Safety)

Quality of monitoring, anticipation and reporting on progress and quality

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering
• 3/5 years of experience/knowledge on field work execution in the railway sector. If this experience is in signalling and infrastructure activities, especially with ADIF, it will be a plus.
• Experience in management and evaluation of subcontractors
• Orientation and experience in EHS and AZDP control
• High level of English is a must
• Availability to travel is required
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

jobs_results.title: Internship Event Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.

This position will support Fever Originals’ team. Your role will be to help the project manager with her daily tasks. This is an exciting opportunity to join the team at an early, high-growth stage and have ownership in creating new experiences.

The role requires a mix of business development and... operational experience. Candidates need to be passionate about the entertainment and events industry. You will have to be comfortable delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners, and think bigger about how we create a compelling experience.

This role requires flexibility, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines while staying within budget.

Strong communication skills are critical to success in this role. The right candidate will be a self-starter and have strong interpersonal skills.

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble, learn, and work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Participate in all aspects of event productions, including pre-production logistics planning, vendor selection, hiring, onsite execution, as well as post-event wrap-up
• Create productions timelines and ensure that teams are keeping to schedule
• Communicate and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive alignment and execution of event deliverables
• Manage multiple productions and help scale this Fever Original IP against team targets
• Deep dive in budgets of different scales
• Venue research and booking
• Handle administrative duties including expense reports, invoicing, and working with the legal department on contracts

REQUIREMENTS
• Native-level Spanish and fluent English skills
• Preferably having already an experience in the event production industry
• Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and pull together multiple aspects of a project in an organized and efficient way
• Understanding of technical production requirements
• Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
• You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then try to find solutions
• Have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships
• Able to communicate with partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
• Collaborative and willing to “get hands dirty”
• Availability to travel

You’re about to graduate and have strong analytical and communication skills. You’re thriving in a fast-growing and demanding environment and are happy to take ownership of exciting projects.

BENEFITS
• Paid internship
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
• Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
• Home office friendly
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
• We have free food, drink, and fruit at the office!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Clinical Project Manager II, Spain  - P - HQ00003015
jobs_results.description:
Location: Spain - Home based

Schedule: Freelance, Various FTEs

CROMSOURCE is a growing international CRO dedicated to a quality-focused approach with a collaborative "one-team" culture, and we are looking for a dynamic person to join our in-house team as a Freelance Clinical Project Manager II, to join their clinical operations team in Spain. This is a full-time opportunity. You will work on projects from our varied client base, ranging from small to mid-sized pharma and medical device companies.

As a Clinical Project Manager II, you will be responsible for managing the clinical projects and ensuring the quality of the services in accordance with contractual obligations, applicable SOPs, ICH-GCP guidelines, and other applicable regulations.

Join our team and help us deliver clinical trials that will improve patients' lives.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:
• Manage and coordinate the assigned clinical projects
• Manage all project-specific services required by the Sponsor... (central lab exams, drug shipments, document shipments, etc.)
• Manage the correct development of the clinical project, interacting with the Sponsor and the Investigators and properly coordinating the project team members
• Keep professionally abreast of all scientific, regulatory, and operational aspects relevant to the clinical projects assigned
• Knowledgeable in the application process for clinical studies, in force in the country/ies of work.
• Collect and manage study data documentation (CRFs, patient diaries, questionnaires, queries, study supplies, regulatory documents, correspondence, etc.)
• May act as a Technical Specialist supervising the projects within specific therapeutic and technical areas
• Assure the proper timelines of the assigned projects
• Manage the budget for the project
• Monitor the workload and the performance of the project team
• Plan and monitor the tasks of the team in the specific areas
• Coordinate the Clinical Research Associates and Clinical Monitors activity
• Collaborate with Clinical Trial Administrators and Clinical Research Associates in terms of local authorities' approval activities
• Collaborate in the overall management of the project with the assigned Biometrics team and with all other project team members involved in the delivery of specific activities (such as Safety, Regulatory, etc.)
• Collaborate with the CTAs in archiving activities
• Assist the Medical Monitor in preparing protocols, Case Report Forms, and final Clinical Study Reports
• Deliver project-specific training
• Organise and participate in Monitor and Investigator Meetings
• Organise or take part in the periodic project update meetings
• Provide project updates to the Sponsor, Senior Project Manager, and Project Director/Leader as required
• Inform the Project Director/Leader about any issues
• Perform co-monitoring visits for the assigned clinical projects as necessary
• Act as a tutor for Project Coordinators and Project Managers I
• Maintain relationships with the Sponsor, including providing project updates
• Prepare the SOPs relating to clinical research activities in collaboration with the Quality System Unit
• Collaborate in complying with enforcing Company procedures

Education and Experience Required:
• University Degree in scientific, medical, or paramedical disciplines
• Proven experience in clinical project management activities, 5 plus years in the CRO/pharmaceutical industry including previous experience as a CRA or similar
• Excellent knowledge of clinical trial operations, GCP/ICH Guidelines, and other applicable regulatory requirements
• Fluent in English and local language(s)
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook)
• Willingness to travel

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgment email. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for a phone interview as the first step. 

If you would like to discuss the role before applying through the website @ http://www.cromsource.com/careers/job-vacancies please contact careers@cromsource.com for more information.

Who will you be working for?

About CROMSOURCE   

CROMSOURCE is a family-owned international, full-service Contract Research Organisation that, since 1994, has been supporting our clients with outstanding clinical research and staffing solutions services. The successful growth of CROMSOURCE has been achieved by putting high quality and client focus at the heart of everything we do.               

Our Company Ethos

Our employees are the most valuable company asset. We value our resources and ensure they work in a friendly, family environment so they are able to develop their skills and talents. Human Resources is the fulcrum around which all CROMSOURCE activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. Continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below-industry average turnover rates.

CROMSOURCE is an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in relation to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected status. CROMSOURCE is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Keywords: Senior Project Manager, Clinical Project Manager, Senior Study Manager, Study Management Associate, Project Management Associate, Clinical, Drugs, Medical Devices, Clinical Trial Management, Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Study Manager, Clinical Study Management, Project Leader, Project Lead, CRO, Clinical Research Organisation, Contract Research Organisation
